## Roadmap ID and milestone
E.g. DEMO-01 / Milestone A

## Owner and dependencies
Assign yourself; list linked blockers and code areas.

## User outcome and scope
Describe what changes and what is explicitly deferred.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Concrete behavior and scenario
- [ ] Failure/negative/cancellation cases
- [ ] Reproducible evidence and known limits

## Verification plan
Use fictional fixtures. State if tests touch audio devices, restart apps, require network/provider access or must run with no call active.
